answer: Cross-epoch behaviour fingerprinting. Derive a per-identity behavioural fingerprint each epoch from interaction timing, counterparty mix, and action sequences, then require the fingerprint to sit on a stable ridge across the last N epochs; drift beyond a threshold demands re-earning history. Cold-start identities get one small echo of early weight, decaying fast. Any cluster whose fingerprints resync in lockstep is flagged and throttled like a single actor under shale-style layered penalties.
